substitutionTest.rule: R-CAUTIOUS-HALF, substitution form, run as standing procedure before any pairing test
substitutionTest.note: The section is display matter only: the part label, the divider, and the OPENING label. Zero testable baseline sentences, so the section is in display mode and no pairing test applies. Method: baseline sentences of four or more words, emphasis and punctuation normalized to the straight convention, display and divider lines excluded, an italic coda counted as a single unit; counts therefore differ where the earlier record used another window or where the 2026-07-31 restorations landed.

audits.checked: Title matter byte-diffed against the baseline above PART ONE. Five divergences, none reconciled: the baseline's plain half-title line THE SMALLEST NEST is absent; the display title reads THE NEST against the baseline's THE SMALLEST NEST; the subtitle reads A field guide to humanity's most viable future against Suited for Containing a Dragon Named Earth; and both part labels use the census colon form against the baseline's middle-dot form. The title and subtitle sit under CTD-0035 and the card's open author decision on the final title-matter convention; the part labels and title are structural lines fixed by the census and held for the continuity workflow. The asterisk-operator divider is the recorded repair of the baseline's em dash divider and is the same glyph verified Volume V uses. R-PAIRED-DELETION, R-TENSE, R-DEIXIS: nothing to run against display matter.
audits.prose: No prose change. The 29-line structural census matches exactly after the audit.
audits.conclusion: Holds under the twenty rules. Display matter only; the title-matter divergences are inventoried against their recorded decisions and flagged to the author, not reconciled.
